title: Band paani kar diya
body:
Band paani kar diya aale payambar ke liye
Mar gaye at'faale sarwar ek saaghar ke liye
Saath mera chodh do as'haab se kehte the shaah
Saare jhagde ho rahe hai ek mere sar ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaah kehte the koi aulaad waala kya nahi
Thoda sa paani jo dede mere asghar ke liye Phir nazar ki sooe nehre alqama aur ye kaha
Mere gheerat'daar kya kehte ho quaahar ke liye
ho bhare darbaar me jab daaqela hamsheer ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Kuch to karna intezaam us waqt chaadar ke liye
Aaya'e tat'heer ke maalik the ab wo kya karei'n
Betiyaa'n zahra ki hai mohtaaj chaadar ke liye
Hil gaye dil koofe waalo ke jo zainab ne kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
Zulm jo chaahe karo aale payambar ke liye
Kya karu'n bhai mera shaane kataakar so gaya
Warna mai mohtaaj hoti ek chaadar ke liye
